what: 1 vs 2 uvicorn workers, mixed workload (half repeats, half unique), loopback on the box, rate limit off
note: first 1-worker attempt measured the rate limiter, not the service (429s from the per-process 240/min bucket); rerun with the limiter off
decision: keep 2 workers: p50s within noise, 2 workers hold the better p95 at c4/c16 and keep a second failure domain. cost: each worker warms its own caches, so a cold query can flip between llm and heuristic answers for ~1s until both land
